Countdown to Bitcoin Block #1,000,000: 23,178 blocks remaining.

What happens when we stop treating compute heat as waste and start measuring civilizational success by how fast we uplift the most vulnerable populations?

At Regenerative Compute (regenerativecompute.io), we pair open-source ASICs with closed-loop water harvesting (MOF-303), Terra Preta biochar, and hydroponics—starting from a $42 Bitaxe topper on a desk in Sydney and scaling to solar microgrids in Madagascar and Martian lava tubes.

Low time preference. 114 years (2026–2140). Every watt warms life.

posts.hook_en: Every watt entering a CMOS gate exits as 100% Joule heat. When you snap a closed-loop biosphere dome onto a 17W Bitaxe Gamma 601, SHA-256 stops being 'waste heat' and becomes a self-watering micro-climate.
posts.hook_fr: Chaque watt entrant dans une porte CMOS ressort à 100 % sous forme de chaleur Joule. En couplant un dôme biosphérique fermé sur un Bitaxe Gamma 601 de 17 W, SHA-256 devient un micro-climat auto-irrigué.
